C1157.title: Major Loopholes Found in 'Teen Mode' on Short-Video Platforms
C1157.summary: An investigation by Southern Metropolis Daily found significant gaps in minor online safety protections on some platforms. WeChat Channels' teen mode can be bypassed by resetting the password via SMS verification code, while apps like Douyin and Kuaishou allow users to circumvent time limits simply by uninstalling and reinstalling, rendering the teen mode ineffective.

references.title: Huge Loopholes in 'Youth Mode'! Some Short Video Platforms Skirt the Rules
